newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes lower at intraday low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes lower at intraday low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan continued its downward trend on Thursday to close at an intra-day low of 8.2960 against the U.S. dollar from Wednesday's 8.2946 on speculative selling ahead of the close, traders said.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2948.
The yuan opened unchanged at 8.2946 and moved in between 8.2945 and 8.2950 for most of the day, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2943 before falling to close at a low, traders said.
Trading was active, with most done at 8.2950, traders said.
"Speculative selling late in the session pushed the yuan down after Wednesday's rebound," one trader said. "The yuan is likely to continue its dowward trend in the short term."

"There were no clear signs of central bank intervention in the market, but worries about it strengthened selling in the yuan," a second trader said. Dealers said they expect the yuan to move below 8.2950 on Friday.
The yuan fell for the eighth day in a row to close down at 6.8332 from 6.8290 against 100 Japanese yen and ended little changed at 1.0718 from 1.0717 against the Hong Kong dollar.
